176-574-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-574-4875.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
176-574-4875.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-4976-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

391-907-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-907-2645-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6006-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4452-5310-6879-8095.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5310-6879-8095.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

575-728-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-728-4674.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

789-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1355-4067-7890.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

549-5414-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5414-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Troubled Healer.

3413-5147-5929.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

215-1526-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-7175.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-5477-6321-6968.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-6968.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1368-2033-4478-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-4478-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

296-6657.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control that have counters on them can tap to produce at least {2}.
Gogo has a counter on it.
296-6657.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Thirteenth Doctor triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control that have counters on them by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying The Thirteenth Doctor's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The Thirteenth Doctor's trigger, untapping all creatures you control that have a counter on them.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2457-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3621-4659-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
3621-4659-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-3680--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Stunt Double that has haste. Choose to have Stunt Double enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Stunt Double token instead.
618-3680--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Stunt Double's toughness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-4927-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-4927-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-5530-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5530-6991.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1651-2750-4702-4891.description:
Turn Atsushi into an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-3532-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3532-3949-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact] card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

101-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
101-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake
When Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
101-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

645-1267-2034-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2034-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

1894-2173-3845-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3951-4875-5703-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4875-5703-6798.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4017-5641-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5641-6752.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-4477-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-4477-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

2525-3358-4927.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1308-1563-1879-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-2043-5359.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Threefold Thunderhulk that is a 3/3 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability six times by tapping six of the tokens, adding six {U}.
Repeat.
457-2043-5359.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1329-2178-2511-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2511-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

560-3967-4550-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3967-4550-4616.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Repeat.

804-1525-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
804-1525-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
804-1525-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

220-428-1817-1946.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
220-428-1817-1946.description:
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Ghyrson Starn spell, except it isn't legendary.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells, causing Ghyrson Starn to enter the battlefield and creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 5 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 16, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 16, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 16 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of the token Ghyrson Starn.
Repeat from step 16.

989-1866-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Verdant Eidolon.
989-1866-2882-4999.description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Verdant Eidolon due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by paying {G} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.

500-1809-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-1809-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Returned Pastcaller and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Returned Pastcaller tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2041-2372-2493-4428.description:
Cast Savor the Moment gaining an extra turn.
Move to your end step.
Thassa and Wilderness Reclamation trigger.
Resolve Wilderness Reclamation, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve Thassa's trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and returning it to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters, returning Savor the Moment from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-539-2248-5233.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2751-3557.notablePrerequisites:
You control artifacts that can tap to add at least {2}.
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Brago.
2751-3557.description:
Deal combat damage with Brago.
Brago triggers.
In response, activate artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping itself, copying Brago's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied triggered ability, blinking Strionic Resonator, the artifacts that tapped for mana, and any number of nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
